description:
Ali Siddiq presents Marcus D. Wiley: REHAB, the powerful new full stand-up comedy special focused on fixing marriages, restoring relationships, and best practices for healthy love. This is the highly anticipated follow-up to Marcus’s breakout hit Marriage Is Major Surgery, which has over 5 million views and became one of the most-watched comedy specials of 2025.

In REHAB, Marcus D. Wiley delivers clean, hilarious, and faith-driven storytelling that blends Christian values, relationship wisdom, and stand-up comedy into one unforgettable experience. Known for his family-friendly humor, church-rooted perspective, and relatable marriage insight, Marcus uses comedy to address real-life relationship struggles, communication breakdowns, expectations, and emotional healing in a way that makes people laugh while helping them grow.

This special is for the married, the wanna be married, the used to be married, and the wanna be married again. Through powerful storytelling and practical truth, Marcus positions himself not just as a comedian, but as a trusted Christian relationship voice, using laughter as a tool for restoration, understanding, and unity.

Whether you’re dating, engaged, married, or rebuilding, REHAB brings comedy with purpose, faith with humor, and entertainment with impact.

🔥 Watch the full special now and experience clean Christian comedy that heals and hilariously tells the truth.
🙏 Like, comment, and subscribe for more comedy, relationship storytelling, and stand-up specials from Ali Siddiq and Marcus D. Wiley.
